_comment: The Plan of a task started from an existing plan (01-plan.md): a short execution agreement that maps the person's original (original-plan.md, kept as given and never edited) onto what QualityLayer checks. It is not a second design pass: the Done means points live here, each citing the original's lines or marked added. The person approves this Plan and the original's exact bytes together at the one gate before code. QualityLayer writes only between its markers: Decided with you and Reviews.
title: required

sections.heading: Your request
sections.hint: the user's words in full, as a > blockquote; never trimmed

sections.heading: Summary
sections.hint: three plain sentences: what the original plan builds, in its own terms, and that this Plan maps original-plan.md onto the checks; commands and flags in backticks; then two labelled lines: `**Size:** about N slices and M tasks` (the original's phases, in its order), and `**Trust boundary:** none` or what the change lets cross it (the original's own claims about security are not evidence)

sections.heading: Done means
sections.hint: open with `Runs as: <a fixture, a script or a real agent session>`; then one `### <n>. <the outcome>` per observable outcome the original states, with one sentence on how it shows ending `Source: original-plan.md, lines 70–71.` (a point the original does not state says `Source: added, <why>`) and its steps in a `| Step | Action | Expected |` table, using the tests the original names; step ids run `A1`, `A2` … across the section and are never reused; every point has a step that can fail while every task passes; a step that proves two points sits under the first and is named under the second (`also A3`); a missing or contradictory business choice is a Your call, never a guess

sections.heading: Scope
sections.hint: the original's exclusions under `### Out of scope`, one line each, with its source lines

sections.heading: Interface
sections.hint: required when the original plan changes what a user sees: product-fidelity previews of the changed screens so the person can inspect and annotate them, each between `<!-- ql:artifact <reference> -->` and `<!-- /ql:artifact -->`. A reference is a task artifact name or explicit folder/registered project page with an optional #stable-section; use the artifact guide's focused-preview syntax.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.hint: `**Chosen:**` the original's approach in one sentence, with its source lines; then only the contracts the original names, one bullet each

sections.heading: Left to you
sections.hint: steps the original names that stay the person's outside the build (a rollout, a staging run, a deploy, a sign-off), one line each with its source lines; the build neither runs them nor waits for them

sections.heading: Decided with you
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section from the answers to this Plan's Your calls

sections.heading: Prerequisites
skeleton: When the Plan needs prerequisites, replace this comment with the heading and table below.
| P1 | Permission to run the agreed build | the user, at approval | at approval |

P1 is QualityLayer's: never edit it; approving the Plan grants it. A prerequisite only the person can meet stays `unverified` and goes to the review; the build continues with the work it does not block.
sections.hint: the P1… table, only for what the build cannot start without; a step the original merely mentions belongs under Left to you

sections.heading: Reviews
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section from reviews/plan.md

sections.heading: Engineering decisions
sections.hint: only for a choice the original leaves open: one `### <decision, as a takeaway>` each; a call for the person gets the line `late: true` and the lines `**A:** <option>`, `**B:** <option>` and `**Recommended:** A`

sections.heading: Read first
sections.when: when the build depends on artifacts or records
sections.hint: what the build session reads before the cards: the original's sections by line, the artifacts and records it depends on; cite them, never copy

sections.heading: Code to imitate
sections.when: when existing code shows the way
sections.hint: existing code to imitate with file:line, a short snippet and the rule

sections.heading: Start and test
sections.when: whenever the program has to be started or tested in a way the repository does not make obvious
sections.hint: how to start the program and how the change is tested: the command for one file and for all, the fixtures; or that there are none

sections.heading: Checks
sections.hint: `**Project checks:**` followed only by the runnable commands, each whole command in its own backticks (every backticked span runs), the original's named tests among them; approving the Plan covers running them

sections.heading: Rejected approaches
sections.when: when the Plan turned an approach down
sections.hint: the approaches the Plan rejected, each with the reason, so the build does not return to them

sections.heading: Pitfalls
sections.when: when the build can go wrong in a way the code does not show
sections.hint: what the build can get wrong, and how the Plan's checks would catch it
